name: iBeat_mixed_questions
description: Mixed post-trial questions: 80% sync-detection, 6% flash-detection, 6% left/right, 8% image-identification (30 trials: 12 sync + 1 of each other question, separately for the 15 sync and 15 async trials). Peaks-only (ECG) input signal, with the default peak-envelope timings carried explicitly so this preset doesn't depend on whatever config.js happens to default to. Eye tracking left to the experimenter controls.

questions.text: Hat der Fisch genau zu deinem Herzschlag gepasst?
Hast du den rosa Fisch blinken sehen?
War der Fisch links oder rechts?
Hast du den linken oder den rechten Fisch gesehen?
